propositions: git commit --amend -m/-F replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
The prepare-commit-msg hook cannot distinguish an amend with -F from a fresh -F commit (both report source='message' sha=''), so it cannot preserve the Change-Id on amend
A make amend-msg FILE=<path> wrapper must read HEAD's Change-Id, strip any Change-Id from FILE, and reinsert the original Change-Id via git interpret-trailers before amending
The wrapper must fail loudly and non-zero when HEAD carries no Change-Id rather than amending silently
AGENTS.md must document make amend-msg as the required path for rewritten commit messages and warn that --amend -m/-F drop Change-Id and create duplicate changes
